free_tier.stated: no free tier; the 512 MB plan is JPY 590 a month equivalent or JPY 7,078 a year, and the 1 GB plan is JPY 807 a month equivalent

retention.stated: the instance persists while the plan is paid; there is no setup fee (初期費用無料)

egress.terms: no traffic quota is printed on the specification page read; the plan table states CPU, memory and SSD only

interface_detail: root SSH; the vendor's web console; a REST API where documented
chaining: the cheapest Japanese machine from a large domestic host, at 512 MB it is a WireGuard node or a DNS secondary rather than a daily driver

limits.value: no traffic allowance stated on the page read

binding_note: 512 MB of RAM and a 25 GB disk bind before anything else; the next plan at 1 GB is JPY 807, which is USD 5.15 and over the line

identity_cost.detail: email signup, then a phone verification by automated voice call before the VPS can be used: '「さくらのクラウド」や「さくらのVPS」など一部のサービスは、電話認証が完了するまで利用できません。' The verification screen offers a country selector: '1電話番号・国を選択し、「音声電話で認証コードを受け取る」をクリックします。' A card is the default payment method; the flow page names 電話番号認証 as the last signup step. Whether a non-Japanese number is accepted was not tested

confidence_note: plan prices and shapes from the specification page read today; the phone-verification gate from Sakura's own flow and support pages
